ayahs.ar: يَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنِ الۡاَنۡفَالِؕ قُلِ الۡاَنۡفَالُ لِلّٰهِ وَالرَّسُوۡلِۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَصۡلِحُوۡا ذَاتَ بَيۡنِكُمۡࣕ وَاَطِيۡعُوا اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوۡلَهٗ٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yas'aloonaka 'anil anfaali qulil anfaalu lillaahi war Rasooli fattaqul laaha wa ahlihoo zaata bainikum wa atee'ul laaha wa Rasoolahooo in kuntum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the bounties [of war]. Say, "The [decision concerning] bounties is for Allah and the Messenger." So fear Allah and amend that which is between you and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you should be believers.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا ذُكِرَ اللّٰهُ وَجِلَتۡ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ وَاِذَا تُلِيَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُهٗ زَادَتۡهُمۡ اِيۡمَانًا وَّعَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَۚۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innamal mu'minoonal lazeena izaa zukiral laahu wajilat quloobuhum wa izaa tuliyat 'alaihim Aayaatuhoo zaadat hum eemaananw wa 'alaa Rabbihim yatawakkaloon
ayahs.en: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely -

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يُقِيۡمُوۡنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yuqeemoonas Salaata wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
ayahs.en: The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ حَقًّاؕ لَهُمۡ دَرَجٰتٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَمَغۡفِرَةٌ وَّرِزۡقٌ كَرِيۡمٌۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika humul mu'minoona haqqaa; lahum darajaatun 'inda Rabbihim wa magh firatunw wa rizqun kareem
ayahs.en: Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees [of high position] with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision.

ayahs.ar: كَمَا٘ اَخۡرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنۭۡ بَيۡتِكَ بِالۡحَقِّࣕ وَاِنَّ فَرِيۡقًا مِّنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ لَكٰرِهُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Kaamaaa akhrajaka Rabbuka mim baitika bilhaqq; wa inna fareeqam minal mu'mineena lakaarihoon
ayahs.en: [It is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of Badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling,

ayahs.ar: يُجَادِلُوۡنَكَ فِي الۡحَقِّ بَعۡدَ مَا تَبَيَّنَ كَاَنَّمَا يُسَاقُوۡنَ اِلَي الۡمَوۡتِ وَهُمۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yujaadiloonaka fil haqqi ba'da maa tabaiyana kaannamaa yasaaqoona ilal mawti wa hum uanzuroon
ayahs.en: Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ يَعِدُكُمُ اللّٰهُ اِحۡدَي الطَّآئِفَتَيۡنِ اَنَّهَا لَكُمۡ وَتَوَدُّوۡنَ اَنَّ غَيۡرَ ذَاتِ الشَّوۡكَةِ تَكُوۡنُ لَكُمۡ وَيُرِيۡدُ اللّٰهُ اَنۡ يُّحِقَّ الۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖ وَيَقۡطَعَ دَابِرَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz ya'idukumul laahu ihdat taaa'ifataini annahaa lakum wa tawaddoona anna ghaira zaatish shawkati takoonu lakum wa yureedul laahu ai yuhiqqal haqqa bikalimaatihee wa taqta'a daabiral kaafireen
ayahs.en: [Remember, O believers], when Allah promised you one of the two groups - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. But Allah intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers

ayahs.ar: لِيُحِقَّ الۡحَقَّ وَيُبۡطِلَ الۡبَاطِلَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Liyuhiqqal haqqa wa tubtilal baatila wa law karihal mujrimoon
ayahs.en: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ تَسۡتَغِيۡثُوۡنَ رَبَّكُمۡ فَاسۡتَجَابَ لَكُمۡ اَنِّيۡ مُمِدُّكُمۡ بِاَلۡفٍ مِّنَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ مُرۡدِفِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz tastagheesoona Rabbakum fastajaaba lakum annee mumiddukum bi alfim minal malaaa'ikati murdifeen
ayahs.en: [Remember] when you asked help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بُشۡرٰي وَلِتَطۡمَئِنَّ بِهٖ قُلُوۡبُكُمۡؕ وَمَا النَّصۡرُ اِلَّا مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيۡزٌ حَكِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa ja'alahul laahu illaa bushraa wa litatma'inna bihee quloobukum; wa man nasru illaa min 'indil laah; innal laaha Azeezun Hakeem
ayahs.en: And Allah made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allah. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ يُغَشِّيۡكُمُ النُّعَاسَ اَمَنَةً مِّنۡهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً لِّيُطَهِّرَكُمۡ بِهٖ وَيُذۡهِبَ عَنۡكُمۡ رِجۡزَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ وَلِيَرۡبِطَ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الۡاَقۡدَامَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz yughashsheekumun nu'assa amanatam minhu wa yunazzilu 'alaikum minas samaaa'i maaa'al liyutah hirakum bihee wa yuzhiba 'ankum rijzash Shaitaani wa liyarbita 'ala quloobikum wa yusabbita bihil aqdaam
ayahs.en: [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ يُوۡحِيۡ رَبُّكَ اِلَي الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اَنِّيۡ مَعَكُمۡ فَثَبِّتُوا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاؕ سَاُلۡقِيۡ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوا الرُّعۡبَ فَاضۡرِبُوۡا فَوۡقَ الۡاَعۡنَاقِ وَاضۡرِبُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ كُلَّ بَنَانٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz yoohee Rabbuka ilal malaaa'ikati annee ma'akum fasabbitul lazeena aamanoo; sa ulqee fee quloobil lazeena kafarur ru'ba fadriboo fawqal a'naaqi wadriboo minhum kulla banaan
ayahs.en: [Remember] when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip."

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ شَآقُّوا اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوۡلَهٗۚ وَمَنۡ يُّشَاقِقِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوۡلَهٗ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِيۡدُ الۡعِقَابِ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annahum shaaaqqul laaha wa Rasoolah; wa mai yushaqiqil laaha wa Rasoolahoo fa innal laaha shadeedul 'iqaab
ayahs.en: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكُمۡ فَذُوۡقُوۡهُ وَاَنَّ لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ عَذَابَ النَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Zaalikum fazooqoohu wa anna lilkaafireena 'azaaban Naar
ayahs.en: "That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِذَا لَقِيۡتُمُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا زَحۡفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوۡهُمُ الۡاَدۡبَارَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhal lazeena aamanoo izaa laqeetumul lazeena kafaroo zahfan falaa tuwalloohumul adbaar
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [for battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight].

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يُّوَلِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهٗ٘ اِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِّقِتَالٍ اَوۡ مُتَحَيِّزًا اِلٰي فِئَةٍ فَقَدۡ بَآءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَمَاۡوٰىهُ جَهَنَّمُؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡمَصِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Wa mai yuwallihim yawma'izin duburahooo illaa mutaharrifal liqitaalin aw mutahaiyizan ilaa fi'atin faqad baaa'a bighadabim minal laahi wa maawaahu Jahannamu wa bi'sal maseer
ayahs.en: And whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving [as a strategy] for war or joining [another] company, has certainly returned with anger [upon him] from Allah, and his refuge is Hell - and wretched is the destination.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمۡ تَقۡتُلُوۡهُمۡ وَلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَتَلَهُمۡࣕ وَمَا رَمَيۡتَ اِذۡ رَمَيۡتَ وَلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَمٰيۚ وَلِيُبۡلِيَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ مِنۡهُ بَلَآءً حَسَنًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيۡعٌ عَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Falam taqtuloohum wa laakinnal laaha qatalahum; wa maa ramaita iz ramaita wa laakinnal laaha ramaa; wa liyubliyal mu'mineena minhu balaaa'an hasanaa; innal laaha Samee'un Aleem
ayahs.en: And you did not kill them, but it was Allah who killed them. And you threw not, [O Muhammad], when you threw, but it was Allah who threw that He might test the believers with a good test. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكُمۡ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ مُوۡهِنُ كَيۡدِ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalikum wa annal laaha moohinu kaidil kaafireen
ayahs.en: That [is so], and [also] that Allah will weaken the plot of the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ تَسۡتَفۡتِحُوۡا فَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمُ الۡفَتۡحُۚ وَاِنۡ تَنۡتَهُوۡا فَهُوَ خَيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡۚ وَاِنۡ تَعُوۡدُوۡا نَعُدۡۚ وَلَنۡ تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡكُمۡ فِئَتُكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَوۡ كَثُرَتۡۙ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: In tastaftihoo faqad jaaa'akumul fathu wa in tantahoo fahuwa khairul lakum wa in ta'oodoo na'ud wa lan tughniya 'ankum fi'atukum shai'anw wa law kasurat wa annal laaha ma'al mu'mineen
ayahs.en: If you [disbelievers] seek the victory - the defeat has come to you. And if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], We will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because Allah is with the believers.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اَطِيۡعُوا اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوۡلَهٗ وَلَا تَوَلَّوۡا عَنۡهُ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَسۡمَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhal lazeena aamanoo atee'ul laaha wa Rasoolahoo wa laa tawallaw 'anhu wa antum tasm'oon
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, obey Allah and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order].

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا كَالَّذِيۡنَ قَالُوۡا سَمِعۡنَا وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa takoonoo kallazeena qaaloo sami'naa wa hum laa yasma'oon
ayahs.en: And do not be like those who say, "We have heard," while they do not hear.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَآبِّ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ الصُّمُّ الۡبُكۡمُ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna sharrad dawaaabbi 'indal laahis summul bukmul lazeena laa ya'qiloon
ayahs.en: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ عَلِمَ اللّٰهُ فِيۡهِمۡ خَيۡرًا لَّاَسۡمَعَهُمۡؕ وَلَوۡ اَسۡمَعَهُمۡ لَتَوَلَّوۡا وَّهُمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law 'alimal laahu feehim khairal la asma'ahum; wa law asma'ahum latawallaw wa hum mu'ridoon
ayahs.en: Had Allah known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوا اسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لِلّٰهِ وَلِلرَّسُوۡلِ اِذَا دَعَاكُمۡ لِمَا يُحۡيِيۡكُمۡۚ وَاعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَحُوۡلُ بَيۡنَ الۡمَرۡءِ وَقَلۡبِهٖ وَاَنَّهٗ٘ اِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhal lazeena aamanus tajeeboo lillaahi wa lir Rasooli izaa da'aakum limaa yuhyeekum wa'lamooo annal laaha yahoolu bainal mar'i wa qalbihee wa anahooo ilaihi tuhsharoon
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّقُوۡا فِتۡنَةً لَّا تُصِيۡبَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡكُمۡ خَآصَّةًۚ وَاعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِيۡدُ الۡعِقَابِ
ayahs.tl: Wattaqoo fitnatal laa tuseebannal lazeena zalamoo minkum khaaaassatanw wa'lamooo annal laaha shadeedul 'iqaab
ayahs.en: And fear a trial which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allah is severe in penalty.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرُوۡ٘ا اِذۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَلِيۡلٌ مُّسۡتَضۡعَفُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ تَخَافُوۡنَ اَنۡ يَّتَخَطَّفَكُمُ النَّاسُ فَاٰوٰىكُمۡ وَاَيَّدَكُمۡ بِنَصۡرِهٖ وَرَزَقَكُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wazkurooo iz antum qaleelum mustad 'afoona filardi takhaafoona ai yatakhat tafakumun naasu fa aawaakum wa aiyadakum binasrihee wa razaqakum minat taiyibaati la'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.en: And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things - that you might be grateful.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَا تَخُوۡنُوا اللّٰهَ وَالرَّسُوۡلَ وَتَخُوۡنُوۡ٘ا اَمٰنٰتِكُمۡ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa takhoonal laaha war Rasoola wa takhoonooo amaanaatikum wa antum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, do not betray Allah and the Messenger or betray your trusts while you know [the consequence].

ayahs.ar: وَاعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّمَا٘ اَمۡوَالُكُمۡ وَاَوۡلَادُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٌۙ وَّاَنَّ اللّٰهَ عِنۡدَهٗ٘ اَجۡرٌ عَظِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa'lamooo annamaaa amwaalukum wa awlaadukum fitnatunw wa annal laaha 'indahooo ajrun azeem
ayahs.en: And know that your properties and your children are but a trial and that Allah has with Him a great reward.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ تَتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ يَجۡعَلۡ لَّكُمۡ فُرۡقَانًا وَّيُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡكُمۡ سَيِّاٰتِكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ ذُو الۡفَضۡلِ الۡعَظِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhal lazeena aamanooo in tattaqul laaha yaj'al lakum furqaananw wa yukaffir 'ankum saiyi aatikum wa yaghfir lakum; wallaahu zul fadlil 'azeem
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, if you fear Allah, He will grant you a criterion and will remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ يَمۡكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِيُثۡبِتُوۡكَ اَوۡ يَقۡتُلُوۡكَ اَوۡ يُخۡرِجُوۡكَؕ وَيَمۡكُرُوۡنَ وَيَمۡكُرُ اللّٰهُؕ وَاللّٰهُ خَيۡرُ الۡمٰكِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz yamkuru bikal lazeena kafaroo liyusbitooka aw yaqtulooka aw yukhrijook; wa yamkuroona wa yamkurul laahu wallaahu khairul maakireen
ayahs.en: And [remember, O Muhammad], when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالُوۡا قَدۡ سَمِعۡنَا لَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَقُلۡنَا مِثۡلَ هٰذَا٘ۙ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa qaaloo qad sami'naa law nashaaa'u laqulnaa misla haazaaa in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen
ayahs.en: And when Our verses are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we willed, we could say [something] like this. This is not but legends of the former peoples."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالُوا اللّٰهُمَّ اِنۡ كَانَ هٰذَا هُوَ الۡحَقَّ مِنۡ عِنۡدِكَ فَاَمۡطِرۡ عَلَيۡنَا حِجَارَةً مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اَوِ ائۡتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaalul laahumma in kaana haazaa huwal haqqa min 'indika fa amtir 'alainaa hijaaratam minas samaaa'i awi'tinaa bi 'azaabin alaeem
ayahs.en: And [remember] when they said, "O Allah, if this should be the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمۡ وَاَنۡتَ فِيۡهِمۡؕ وَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kanal laahu liyu'az zibahum wa anta feehim; wa maa kaanal laahu mu'az zibahum wa hum yastaghfiroon
ayahs.en: But Allah would not punish them while you, [O Muhammad], are among them, and Allah would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لَهُمۡ اَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَهُمۡ يَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنِ الۡمَسۡجِدِ الۡحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوۡ٘ا اَوۡلِيَآءَهٗؕ اِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآؤُهٗ٘ اِلَّا الۡمُتَّقُوۡنَ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa lahum allaa yu'az zibahumul laahu wa hum yasuddoona 'anil Masjidil-Haraami wa maa kaanooo awliyaaa'ah; in awliyaaa' uhooo illal muttaqoona wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: But why should Allah not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al- Haram and they were not [fit to be] its guardians? Its [true] guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمۡ عِنۡدَ الۡبَيۡتِ اِلَّا مُكَآءً وَّتَصۡدِيَةًؕ فَذُوۡقُوا الۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaana Salaatuhum 'indal Baiti illa mukaaa anw-wa tasdiyah; fazooqul 'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
ayahs.en: And their prayer at the House was not except whistling and handclapping. So taste the punishment for what you disbelieved.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يُنۡفِقُوۡنَ اَمۡوَالَهُمۡ لِيَصُدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِؕ فَسَيُنۡفِقُوۡنَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُوۡنُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَسۡرَةً ثُمَّ يُغۡلَبُوۡنَ ࣢ؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي جَهَنَّمَ يُحۡشَرُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena kafaroo yunfiqoona amwaalahum liyasuddoo 'an sabeelil laah; fasayunfiqoonahaa summa takoonu 'alaihim hasratan summa yughlaboon; wal lazeena kafarooo ilaa Jahannnama yuhsharoona
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to avert [people] from the way of Allah. So they will spend it; then it will be for them a [source of] regret; then they will be overcome. And those who have disbelieved - unto Hell they will be gathered.

ayahs.ar: لِيَمِيۡزَ اللّٰهُ الۡخَبِيۡثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَيَجۡعَلَ الۡخَبِيۡثَ بَعۡضَهٗ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍ فَيَرۡكُمَهٗ جَمِيۡعًا فَيَجۡعَلَهٗ فِيۡ جَهَنَّمَؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Liyameezal laahul khabeesa minat taiyibi wa yaj'alal khabeesa ba'dahoo 'ala ba'din fayarkumahoo jamee'an fayaj'alahoo fee Jahannnam; ulaaa'ika humul khaasiroon
ayahs.en: [This is] so that Allah may distinguish the wicked from the good and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together and put them into Hell. It is those who are the losers.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ يَّنۡتَهُوۡا يُغۡفَرۡ لَهُمۡ مَّا قَدۡ سَلَفَۚ وَاِنۡ يَّعُوۡدُوۡا فَقَدۡ مَضَتۡ سُنَّتُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul lillazeena kafarooo iny yantahoo yughfar lahum maa qad salafa wa iny ya'oodoo faqad madat sunnatul awwaleen
ayahs.en: Say to those who have disbelieved [that] if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return [to hostility] - then the precedent of the former [rebellious] peoples has already taken place.

ayahs.ar: وَقَاتِلُوۡهُمۡ حَتّٰي لَا تَكُوۡنَ فِتۡنَةٌ وَّيَكُوۡنَ الدِّيۡنُ كُلُّهٗ لِلّٰهِۚ فَاِنِ انۡتَهَوۡا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaatiloohum hattaa laa takoona fitnatunw wa yakoonaddeenu kulluhoo lillaah; fainin tahaw fa innallaaha bimaa ya'maloona Baseer
ayahs.en: And fight them until there is no fitnah and [until] the religion, all of it, is for Allah. And if they cease - then indeed, Allah is Seeing of what they do.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَوۡلٰىكُمۡؕ نِعۡمَ الۡمَوۡلٰي وَنِعۡمَ النَّصِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Wa in tawallaw fa'lamooo annal laaha mawlaakum; ni'mal mawlaa wa ni'man naseer
ayahs.en: But if they turn away - then know that Allah is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and Excellent is the helper.

ayahs.ar: وَاعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّمَا غَنِمۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ فَاَنَّ لِلّٰهِ خُمُسَهٗ وَ لِلرَّسُوۡلِ وَلِذِي الۡقُرۡبٰي وَالۡيَتٰمٰي وَالۡمَسٰكِيۡنِ وَابۡنِ السَّبِيۡلِۙ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ بِاللّٰهِ وَمَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلٰي عَبۡدِنَا يَوۡمَ الۡفُرۡقَانِ يَوۡمَ الۡتَقَي الۡجَمۡعٰنِؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa'lamooo annamaa ghanimtum min sha'in fa anna lillaahi khumusahoo wa lir Rasooli wa lizil qurba walyataamaa walmasaakeeni wabnis sabeeli in kuntum aamantum billaahi wa maaa anzalnaa 'ala 'abdinaa yawmal Furqaani yawmaltaqal jam'aan; wal laahu 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.en: And know that anything you obtain of war booty - then indeed, for Allah is one fifth of it and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and the orphans, the needy, and the [stranded] traveler, if you have believed in Allah and in that which We sent down to Our Servant on the day of criterion - the day when the two armies met. And Allah, over all things, is competent.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ اَنۡتُمۡ بِالۡعُدۡوَةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ بِالۡعُدۡوَةِ الۡقُصۡوٰي وَالرَّكۡبُ اَسۡفَلَ مِنۡكُمۡؕ وَلَوۡ تَوَاعَدۡتُّمۡ لَاخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِي الۡمِيۡعٰدِۙ وَلٰكِنۡ لِّيَقۡضِيَ اللّٰهُ اَمۡرًا كَانَ مَفۡعُوۡلًا ࣢ۙ لِّيَهۡلِكَ مَنۡ هَلَكَ عَنۭۡ بَيِّنَةٍ وَّيَحۡيٰي مَنۡ حَيَّ عَنۭۡ بَيِّنَةٍؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَسَمِيۡعٌ عَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz antum bil'udwatid dunyaa wa hum bil'udwatil quswaa warrakbu asfala minkum; wa law tawaa'attum lakhtalaftum fil mee'aadi wa laakil liyaqdiyal laahu amran kaana maf'oolal liyahlika man halaka 'am baiyinatinw wa yahyaa man haiya 'am baiyinah; wa innal laaha la Samee'un 'Aleem
ayahs.en: [Remember] when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the farther side, and the caravan was lower [in position] than you. If you had made an appointment [to meet], you would have missed the appointment. But [it was] so that Allah might accomplish a matter already destined - that those who perished [through disbelief] would perish upon evidence and those who lived [in faith] would live upon evidence; and indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ يُرِيۡكَهُمُ اللّٰهُ فِيۡ مَنَامِكَ قَلِيۡلًاؕ وَلَوۡ اَرٰىكَهُمۡ كَثِيۡرًا لَّفَشِلۡتُمۡ وَلَتَنَازَعۡتُمۡ فِي الۡاَمۡرِ وَلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَلَّمَؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Iz yureekahumul laahu fee manaamika qaleela; wa law araakahum kaseeral lafashiltum wa latanaaza'tum fil amri wa laakinnal laaha sallam; innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
ayahs.en: [Remember, O Muhammad], when Allah showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter [of whether to fight], but Allah saved [you from that]. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ يُرِيۡكُمُوۡهُمۡ اِذِ الۡتَقَيۡتُمۡ فِيۡ٘ اَعۡيُنِكُمۡ قَلِيۡلًا وَّيُقَلِّلُكُمۡ فِيۡ٘ اَعۡيُنِهِمۡ لِيَقۡضِيَ اللّٰهُ اَمۡرًا كَانَ مَفۡعُوۡلًاؕ وَاِلَي اللّٰهِ تُرۡجَعُ الۡاُمُوۡرُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz yureekumoohum izil taqaitum feee a'yunikum qaleelanw wa yuqallilukum feee a'yunihim liyaqdiyal laahu amran kaana maf'oolaa; wa ilal laahi turja'ul umoor
ayahs.en: And [remember] when He showed them to you, when you met, as few in your eyes, and He made you [appear] as few in their eyes so that Allah might accomplish a matter already destined. And to Allah are [all] matters returned.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِذَا لَقِيۡتُمۡ فِئَةً فَاثۡبُتُوۡا وَاذۡكُرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيۡرًا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhal lazeena aamanooo izaa laqeetum fi'atan fasbutoo wazkurul laaha kaseeral la'allakum tuflihoon
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm and remember Allah much that you may be successful.

ayahs.ar: وَاَطِيۡعُوا اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوۡلَهٗ وَلَا تَنَازَعُوۡا فَتَفۡشَلُوۡا وَتَذۡهَبَ رِيۡحُكُمۡ وَاصۡبِرُوۡاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الصّٰبِرِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa atee'ul laaha wa Rasoolahoo wa laa tanaaza'oo fatafshaloo wa tazhaba reehukum wasbiroo; innal laaha ma'as saabireen
ayahs.en: And obey Allah and His Messenger, and do not dispute and [thus] lose courage and [then] your strength would depart; and be patient. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا كَالَّذِيۡنَ خَرَجُوۡا مِنۡ دِيَارِهِمۡ بَطَرًا وَّرِئَآءَ النَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ مُحِيۡطٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa takoonoo kallazeena kharajoo min diyaarihim bataranw wa ri'aaa'an naasi wa yasuddoona 'an sabeelil laah; wallaahu bimaa ya'maloona muheet
ayahs.en: And do not be like those who came forth from their homes insolently and to be seen by people and avert [them] from the way of Allah. And Allah is encompassing of what they do.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَاِنِّيۡ جَارٌ لَّكُمۡۚ فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَتِ الۡفِئَتٰنِ نَكَصَ عَلٰي عَقِبَيۡهِ وَقَالَ اِنِّيۡ بَرِيۡٓءٌ مِّنۡكُمۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰي مَا لَا تَرَوۡنَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اللّٰهَؕ وَاللّٰهُ شَدِيۡدُ الۡعِقَابِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz zaiyana lahumush shaitaanu a'ma alahum wa qaala laa ghaaliba lakumul yawma minan naasi wa innee jaarul lakum falammaa taraaa'atil fi'ataani nakasa 'alaa aqibaihi wa qaala innee bareee'um minkum innee araa maa laa tarawna inneee akhaaful laah; wallaahu shadeedul 'iqaab
ayahs.en: And [remember] when Satan made their deeds pleasing to them and said, "No one can overcome you today from among the people, and indeed, I am your protector." But when the two armies sighted each other, he turned on his heels and said, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I see what you do not see; indeed I fear Allah. And Allah is severe in penalty."

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ يَقُوۡلُ الۡمُنٰفِقُوۡنَ وَالَّذِيۡنَ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّرَضٌ غَرَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ دِيۡنُهُمۡؕ وَمَنۡ يَّتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَي اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيۡزٌ حَكِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Iz yaqoolul munaafiqoona wallazeena fee quloobihim maradun gharra haaa'ulaaa'i deenuhum; wa mai yatawakkal 'alal laahi fa innal laaha 'azee zun Hakeem
ayahs.en: [Remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease said, "Their religion has deluded those [Muslims]." But whoever relies upon Allah - then indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ تَرٰ٘ي اِذۡ يَتَوَفَّي الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوا الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يَضۡرِبُوۡنَ وُجُوۡهَهُمۡ وَاَدۡبَارَهُمۡۚ وَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابَ الۡحَرِيۡقِ
ayahs.tl: Wa law taraaa iz yatawaf fal lazeena kafarul malaaa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum wa adbaarahum wa zooqoo 'azaabal hareeq
ayahs.en: And if you could but see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved... They are striking their faces and their backs and [saying], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡكُمۡ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَيۡسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلۡعَبِيۡدِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bimaa qaddamat aideekum wa anal laaha laisa bizallaamil lil 'abeed
ayahs.en: That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allah is not ever unjust to His servants."

ayahs.ar: كَدَاۡبِ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَۙ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوۡبِهِمۡؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيۡدُ الۡعِقَابِ
ayahs.tl: Kadaabi Aali Fir'awna wal lazeena min qablihim; kafaroo bi Aayaatil laahi fa akhazahu mul laahu bizunoobihim; innal laaha qawiyyun shadeedul 'iqaab
ayahs.en: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They disbelieved in the signs of Allah, so Allah seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and severe in penalty.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَمۡ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِّعۡمَةً اَنۡعَمَهَا عَلٰي قَوۡمٍ حَتّٰي يُغَيِّرُوۡا مَا بِاَنۡفُسِهِمۡۙ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيۡعٌ عَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annal laaha lam yaku mughaiyiran ni matan an'amahaa 'alaa qawmin hattaa yughaiyiroo maa bianfusihim wa annallaaha samee un 'Aleem
ayahs.en: That is because Allah would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

ayahs.ar: كَدَاۡبِ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَۙ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَاَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ بِذُنُوۡبِهِمۡ وَاَغۡرَقۡنَا٘ اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ وَكُلٌّ كَانُوۡا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kadaabi Aali Fir'awna wallazeena min qablihim; kazzaboo bi Aayaati Rabbihim faahlaknaahum bizunoobihim wa aghraqnaa Aala Fir'awn; wa kullun kaanoo zaalimeen
ayahs.en: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh. And all [of them] were wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَآبِّ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۖۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna sharrad dawaaabbi 'indal laahil lazeena kafaroo fahum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are those who have disbelieved, and they will not [ever] believe -

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ عٰهَدۡتَّ مِنۡهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَنۡقُضُوۡنَ عَهۡدَهُمۡ فِيۡ كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَّهُمۡ لَا يَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena'aahatta min hum summa yanqudoona 'ahdahum fee kulli marratinw wa hum laa yattaqoon
ayahs.en: The ones with whom you made a treaty but then they break their pledge every time, and they do not fear Allah.

ayahs.ar: فَاِمَّا تَثۡقَفَنَّهُمۡ فِي الۡحَرۡبِ فَشَرِّدۡ بِهِمۡ مَّنۡ خَلۡفَهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa immaa tasqafannahum fil harbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum la'allahum yazzakkaroon
ayahs.en: So if you, [O Muhammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.

ayahs.ar: وَاِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِنۡ قَوۡمٍ خِيَانَةً فَانۭۡ بِذۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ عَلٰي سَوَآءٍؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡخَآئِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa immaa takhaafana min qawmin khiyaanatan fambiz ilaihim 'alaa sawaaa'; innal laaha laayuhibbul khaaa'ineen
ayahs.en: If you [have reason to] fear from a people betrayal, throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting you] on equal terms. Indeed, Allah does not like traitors.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَحۡسَبَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا سَبَقُوۡاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ لَا يُعۡجِزُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa yahsabannal lazeena kafaroo sabaqooo; innahum laa yu'jizoon
ayahs.en: And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: وَاَعِدُّوۡا لَهُمۡ مَّا اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ قُوَّةٍ وَّمِنۡ رِّبَاطِ الۡخَيۡلِ تُرۡهِبُوۡنَ بِهٖ عَدُوَّ اللّٰهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمۡ وَاٰخَرِيۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمۡۚ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَهُمۡۚ اَللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُهُمۡؕ وَمَا تُنۡفِقُوۡا مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ يُوَفَّ اِلَيۡكُمۡ وَاَنۡتُمۡ لَا تُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa a'iddoo lahum mastata'tum min quwwatinw wa mirribaatil khaili turhiboona bihee 'aduwwal laahi wa 'aduwwakum wa aakhareena min doonihim laa ta'lamoo nahum Allaahu ya'lamuhum; wa maa tunfiqoo min shai'in fee sabeelil laahi yuwaf failaikum wa antum laa tuzlamoon
ayahs.en: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war by which you may terrify the enemy of Allah and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know [but] whom Allah knows. And whatever you spend in the cause of Allah will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ جَنَحُوۡا لِلسَّلۡمِ فَاجۡنَحۡ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa in janahoo lissalmi fajnah lahaa wa tawakkal 'alal laah; innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: And if they incline to peace, then incline to it [also] and rely upon Allah. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ يُّرِيۡدُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّخۡدَعُوۡكَ فَاِنَّ حَسۡبَكَ اللّٰهُؕ هُوَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَيَّدَكَ بِنَصۡرِهٖ وَبِالۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iny yureedooo any-yakhda'ooka fainna hasbakal laah; Huwal lazeee aiyadaka binasrihee wa bilmu'mineen
ayahs.en: But if they intend to deceive you - then sufficient for you is Allah. It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers

ayahs.ar: وَاَلَّفَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡؕ لَوۡ اَنۡفَقۡتَ مَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًا مَّا٘ اَلَّفۡتَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡۙ وَلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ اَلَّفَ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ عَزِيۡزٌ حَكِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa allafa baina quloobihim; law anfaqta maa fil ardi jamee'am maaa allafta baina quloobihim wa laakinnallaaha allafa bainahum; innaahoo 'Azeezun Hakeem
ayahs.en: And brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together; but Allah brought them together. Indeed, He is Exalted in Might and Wise.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَسۡبُكَ اللّٰهُ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhan Nabiyyu hasbukal laahu wa manittaba 'aka minal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allah and for whoever follows you of the believers.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ عَلَي الۡقِتَالِؕ اِنۡ يَّكُنۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ عِشۡرُوۡنَ صٰبِرُوۡنَ يَغۡلِبُوۡا مِائَتَيۡنِۚ وَاِنۡ يَّكُنۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ مِّائَةٌ يَّغۡلِبُوۡ٘ا اَلۡفًا مِّنَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاَنَّهُمۡ قَوۡمٌ لَّا يَفۡقَهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhan Nabiyyu harridil mu'mineena 'alal qitaal; iny-yakum minkum 'ishroona saabiroona yaghliboo mi'atayn; wa iny-yakum minkum min'atuny yaghlibooo alfam minal lazeena kafaroo bi anahum qawmul laa yafqahoon
ayahs.en: O Prophet, urge the believers to battle. If there are among you twenty [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you one hundred [who are] steadfast, they will overcome a thousand of those who have disbelieved because they are a people who do not understand.

ayahs.ar: اَلۡـٰٔنَ خَفَّفَ اللّٰهُ عَنۡكُمۡ وَعَلِمَ اَنَّ فِيۡكُمۡ ضَعۡفًاؕ فَاِنۡ يَّكُنۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ مِّائَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَّغۡلِبُوۡا مِائَتَيۡنِۚ وَاِنۡ يَّكُنۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ اَلۡفٌ يَّغۡلِبُوۡ٘ا اَلۡفَيۡنِ بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ وَاللّٰهُ مَعَ الصّٰبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Al'aana khaffafal laahu 'ankum wa 'alima anna feekum da'faa; fa-iny yakum minkum mi'atun saabiratuny yaghliboo mi'atayn; wa iny-yakum minkum alfuny yaghlibooo alfaini bi iznil laah; wallaahu ma'as saabireen
ayahs.en: Now, Allah has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness. So if there are from you one hundred [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by permission of Allah. And Allah is with the steadfast.

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ لَهٗ٘ اَسۡرٰي حَتّٰي يُثۡخِنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ تُرِيۡدُوۡنَ عَرَضَ الدُّنۡيَاࣗۖ وَاللّٰهُ يُرِيۡدُ الۡاٰخِرَةَؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَزِيۡزٌ حَكِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Maa kaana li Nabiyyin ai yakoona lahooo asraa hatta yuskhina fil ard; tureedoona aradad dunyaa wallaahu yureedul Aakhirah; wallaahu 'Azeezun Hakeem
ayahs.en: It is not for a prophet to have captives [of war] until he inflicts a massacre [upon Allah 's enemies] in the land. Some Muslims desire the commodities of this world, but Allah desires [for you] the Hereafter. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.

ayahs.ar: لَوۡلَا كِتٰبٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمۡ فِيۡمَا٘ اَخَذۡتُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Law laa Kitaabum minal laahi sabaqa lamassakum fee maaa akhaztum 'azaabun 'azeem
ayahs.en: If not for a decree from Allah that preceded, you would have been touched for what you took by a great punishment.

ayahs.ar: فَكُلُوۡا مِمَّا غَنِمۡتُمۡ حَلٰلًا طَيِّبًاؗۖ وَّاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fakuloo mimaa ghanimtum halaalan taiyibaa; watta qullaah; innal laaha Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلۡ لِّمَنۡ فِيۡ٘ اَيۡدِيۡكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَسۡرٰ٘يۙ اِنۡ يَّعۡلَمِ اللّٰهُ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِكُمۡ خَيۡرًا يُّؤۡتِكُمۡ خَيۡرًا مِّمَّا٘ اُخِذَ مِنۡكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhan Nabiyyu qul liman feee aideekum minal asraaa iny-ya lamillaahu fee quloobikum khairany yu'tikum khayram mimmaaa ukhiza minkum wa yaghfir lakum; wallaahu Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: O Prophet, say to whoever is in your hands of the captives, "If Allah knows [any] good in your hearts, He will give you [something] better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ يُّرِيۡدُوۡا خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدۡ خَانُوا اللّٰهَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَاَمۡكَنَ مِنۡهُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمٌ حَكِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa iny-yureedoo khiyaa nataka faqad khaanullaaha min qablu fa amkana minhum; wallaahu 'aleemum Hakeem
ayahs.en: But if they intend to betray you - then they have already betrayed Allah before, and He empowered [you] over them. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَهَاجَرُوۡا وَجٰهَدُوۡا بِاَمۡوَالِهِمۡ وَاَنۡفُسِهِمۡ فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰوَوۡا وَّنَصَرُوۡ٘ا اُولٰٓئِكَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ اَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٍؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَلَمۡ يُهَاجِرُوۡا مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ وَّلَايَتِهِمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ حَتّٰي يُهَاجِرُوۡاۚ وَاِنِ اسۡتَنۡصَرُوۡكُمۡ فِي الدِّيۡنِ فَعَلَيۡكُمُ النَّصۡرُ اِلَّا عَلٰي قَوۡمٍۭ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ مِّيۡثَاقٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa haajaroo wa jaahadoo bi amwaalihim wa anfusihim fee sabeelil laahi wallazeena aawaw wa nasarooo ulaaa'ika ba'duhum awliyaaa'u ba'd; wallazeena aamanoo wa lam yuhaajiroo maa lakum minw walaayatihim min shai'in hatta yuhaajiroo; wa inistan sarookum fid deeni fa'alaiku munnasru illaa 'alaa qawmim bainakum wa bainahum meesaaq; wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona Baseer
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who have believed and emigrated and fought with their wealth and lives in the cause of Allah and those who gave shelter and aided - they are allies of one another. But those who believed and did not emigrate - for you there is no guardianship of them until they emigrate. And if they seek help of you for the religion, then you must help, except against a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بَعۡضُهُمۡ اَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٍؕ اِلَّا تَفۡعَلُوۡهُ تَكُنۡ فِتۡنَةٌ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيۡرٌؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena kafaroo ba'duhum awliyaaa'u ba'd; illaa taf'aloohu takun fitnatun fil ardi wa fasaadun kabeer
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so, there will be fitnah on earth and great corruption.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَهَاجَرُوۡا وَجٰهَدُوۡا فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰوَوۡا وَّنَصَرُوۡ٘ا اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ حَقًّاؕ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّرِزۡقٌ كَرِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena aamanoo wa haajaroo wa jaahadoo fee sabeelil laahi wallazeena aawaw wa nasarooo ulaaa'ika humul mu'minoona haqqaa; lahum maghfiratunw wa rizqun kareem
ayahs.en: But those who have believed and emigrated and fought in the cause of Allah and those who gave shelter and aided - it is they who are the believers, truly. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدُ وَهَاجَرُوۡا وَجٰهَدُوۡا مَعَكُمۡ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ مِنۡكُمۡؕ وَاُولُوا الۡاَرۡحَامِ بَعۡضُهُمۡ اَوۡلٰي بِبَعۡضٍ فِيۡ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena aamanoo mim ba'du wa haajaroo wa jaahadoo ma;akum faulaaa'ika minkum; wa ulul arhaami baduhum awlaa biba'din fee Kitaabil laah; innal laaha bikulli shai'in 'Aleem
ayahs.en: And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of all things.
